title: Théorie arithmétique. Théorie de Galois des motifs (1965) : notes manuscites (s.d.), tapuscrit (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not a Grothendieck manuscript page. It is a page of an English typescript numbered 'IV.8', likely by another author such as a student or correspondent, filed with the 'Galois theory of motives' notes. The next page notes faint English typescript showing through from the back of the manuscript sheets. Its content is the standard formalism of direct and inverse images for ringed spaces, cited from EGA I, Chapter 0 ('[8, 0; §4.2]', '[8, 0; 4.3.3.1]').

(1) For a continuous map ψ: Y → X there is the adjunction ψ^* ⊣ ψ_* on sheaves of rings. Its counit is σ_{O'}: ψ^*ψ_*(O') → O', the map adjoint to id on ψ_*(O'). Its unit is ρ_O: O → ψ_*ψ^*(O), the map adjoint to id on ψ^*(O).

(2) A morphism of ringed spaces is Ψ = (ψ, θ) with θ: O → ψ_*O'. Through θ, ψ_*M' becomes an O-module, written Ψ_*M'. There are canonical maps:
- h_*: Ψ_* Hom_{O'}(M', N') → Hom_O(Ψ_*M', Ψ_*N');
- t_*: Ψ_*M' ⊗_O Ψ_*N' → Ψ_*(M' ⊗_{O'} N').

(3) The composite σ_{O'} ∘ ψ^*(θ): ψ^*O → O' makes O' a ψ^*O-algebra. One defines Ψ^*M = ψ^*M ⊗_{ψ^*O} O'. There is the canonical isomorphism t^*: Ψ^*M ⊗_{O'} Ψ^*N ≅ Ψ^*(M ⊗_O N).

(4) There is the adjunction Hom_{O'}(Ψ^*M, M') ≅ Hom_O(M, Ψ_*M'). From it come the unit ρ_M: M → Ψ_*Ψ^*M and, as the page breaks off, the counit σ_{M'}: Ψ^*Ψ_*M' → M'.

This is preliminary background, presumably for some later sheaf-theoretic or Tannakian construction in the typescript. It has no direct connection to the neighbouring handwritten pages, which concern Weil numbers M(q) and the motivic Galois group over finite fields.
errors: Typographical: 'ρ_O : → ψ_*ψ^*(O)' is missing its source O.
Typographical: in the definition of t^* the arrow (≅) between Ψ^*(M)⊗_{O'}Ψ^*(N) and Ψ^*(M⊗_O N) is missing.
Typographical: 'σ_{O'} : ψ^*(θ)' should read σ_{O'} ∘ ψ^*(θ).
The reference '[8, 0; 4.33.1]' presumably means EGA 0, 4.3.3.1. Otherwise the mathematics is the standard EGA 0 §4 material and is correct.

deep.surprise_reason: This is an English typescript page by another author restating textbook EGA 0 §4 material on ringed spaces. It is apparently misfiled in, or on the back of, Grothendieck's motivic notes. It contains nothing new or uncredited.

Insert the arrow: 't^* : Ψ^*(M) ⊗_{O'} Ψ^*(N) ≅ Ψ^*(M ⊗_O N)'.
